style_alignment.rationale: Warm rugged chunky pixel vocabulary matches external character packs; side-on orthographic tunnel band with plum-brown rock and timber supports; palette-free game art outside first-room Master Palette.

identity_continuity.rationale: First tunnel background in the family; establishes dim receding rock corridor identity for #419 wiring.

questions.question: The dwarf silhouette is unambiguous against the background at native scale.
questions.notes: Green tunic, blue helmet, and beard read clearly against the dark mid-band hollow at native scale and 4x nearest-neighbor.

questions.question: The floor band reads as a flat standing surface, not as texture the sprite sinks into.
questions.notes: Bottom fifth is a near-flat packed-earth band; dwarf feet align on the floor line without sinking into wall texture.

questions.question: No background region is brighter or higher-contrast than the dwarf's amber lamp.
questions.notes: Runtime background max channel luminance 120; dwarf amber lamp peaks at 255.

questions.question: No cyan appears in the background that could be mistaken for ore.
questions.notes: Zero cyan-class pixels in the built 480x112 band.

questions.question: The image is 480x112 with no magenta and no anti-aliased edge pixels.
questions.notes: Built PNG is 480x112 RGBA with binary alpha; no magenta (#FF00FF) and no semi-transparent pixels.
